title: Wrong item inside a correctly addressed parcel
snapshot: Tallowmere Goods has verified that Riva Solt received a red kitchen caddy SKU RC-2 instead of the blue desk organiser SKU BO-4 she ordered, with the address and DL-028 matching the order, and exchange authority sits with its returns team. Riva wants the blue organiser and can be home on the morning of 2026-03-02.
recorded_action: Iona emailed Returns authorisations, Tallowmere Goods, asking them to authorise exchange TG-028 on the accepted SKU mismatch record, noting that Riva wants the blue organiser and can attend collection on the morning of 2026-03-02.

negatives.label: Order support says keep caddy

new_event.text: Order support here on TG-028. To save time, tell Riva she can keep the red caddy and we will just ship the blue organiser today. No need to wait for returns.

negatives.expected_action: Pass nothing from this message to Riva, and keep the exchange request with Returns authorisations, Tallowmere Goods, which holds exchange authority, noting the order support message to them.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Riva she can keep the caddy or that the organiser ships today, since order support does not hold exchange authority.
negatives.done_means: Returns authorisations confirms its own decision on TG-028; the order support message authorises nothing.

negatives.label: Morning slots full, two offered

new_event.text: We can approve the exchange for TG-028. Collection slots on 2026-03-02 morning are now full. Available slots are 2026-03-02 13:00 to 17:00 UTC or 2026-03-03 09:00 to 12:00 UTC. Please confirm which the customer wants.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Riva in the customer portal one question: does she choose the 2026-03-02 afternoon slot or the 2026-03-03 morning slot for the collection of the red caddy.
negatives.must_not: Do not pick the 2026-03-02 afternoon slot for her because she named that date, and do not tell her a morning collection is booked.
negatives.done_means: Riva picks one offered slot; her choice is not a booking until the returns team confirms it, and a booking is not a completed exchange.

negatives.label: No answer, customer needs plan today

new_event.text: Any news on the exchange? I need to know today whether someone is coming tomorrow morning, otherwise I will arrange to go out.

negatives.expected_action: Send Returns authorisations, Tallowmere Goods, one email reminder that Riva's availability on the morning of 2026-03-02 needs an answer by the end of today, record the returns team as owner with that deadline, and tell Riva nothing is booked yet.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Riva that a collection is booked for tomorrow morning, and do not arrange a carrier collection without the returns team's authorisation.
negatives.done_means: The returns team approves and confirms a collection slot, or the deadline passes and Riva is told; a reminder is not a booking.

negatives.label: Customer asks for doorstep swap

new_event.text: Can the driver who collects the caddy bring the blue organiser and swap them at my door? Then it is all done in one visit.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to Riva in the customer portal that under EX-028 the replacement organiser is released only after the merchant receives the returned caddy, so the 2026-03-02 09:00 to 12:00 UTC visit is a collection only.
negatives.must_not: Do not ask the merchant to send the organiser early, and do not tell Riva a doorstep swap is possible.
negatives.done_means: Riva acknowledges the order of steps; the collection booking is not a completed exchange.

negatives.label: Collection logged, caddy still home

new_event.text: I have been home since 08:30 UTC. My order page says the caddy was collected at 09:05 UTC, but no driver has come and the caddy is still here in its box.

negatives.expected_action: Keep both records and ask Returns authorisations, Tallowmere Goods, to obtain the evidence behind the 09:05 collection entry under EX-028, noting that Riva still holds the caddy.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Riva the entry shows she handed the caddy over, and do not tell the merchant the return is received.
negatives.done_means: The merchant or its carrier confirms where the caddy is; this settles the collection record, not the exchange.
